name: Deepmoss Spider Eggs
objectiveText: Bring 15 Deepmoss Eggs to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet. Deepmoss Egg  ( 15 )

comments.body:
This quest starts in the Barrens but has you going to Stonetalon Mountain, not a bad deal as there are a number of quests in Stonetalon Mountains around this level.

The spider eggs can be found in a number of locations. Sishir Canyon has the highest concentration of spiders and offers the quick route to collecting the eggs. Besseleth is also located in Sishir Canyon, a level 21 elite spider with a quest to kill her.

But the spider eggs can also be found in the forests of Windshear Crag and Mirkfallon Lake.

Stonetalon Mountains: 63,57

Run arround that area you will find the egg under the trees

You'll find this quest a hell of a lot easier if you have a pet/minion/group with you.  About 80% of the time the egg sacs will spawn one or two level 14 Deepmoss Hatchlings, which can do heavy damage if you're not expecting them.  Once you get into the swing of things, you can finish this quest in about 2 minutes, as you'll find up to four eggs per sac.

Also, those egg sacs are just about the nastiest things I've seen in this game.  They look like giant zits.

Due to the random drop about (anywhere from 1-4) you will probably have extra eggs on you after you hand in this quest. These serve no other purpose, can't be vendored or sold on the AH, so you can safely delete them

comments.body:
Also combines well with a spider killing quest you can pick-up in Sunrock Retreat (or maybe it was Honor's Stand?)  I completed them both, fairly easily, solo, as a level 18 mage.

I did not encounter any "egg breakage" problems.  Usually "opening" an egg yielded a hatchling (around level 14) and the broken egg he came from, other junk, plus 1-4 unboken eggs.

Not too hard a quest at all.  If you haven't already done it, another good quest to pick up on your way out to Windshear Crag or Sishir Canyon is Blood Feeders, from a guy in the troll camp at 71,94.

Just be careful with the hatchlings if you're low level.  When their HP gets low they will link with any spiders that are around, and if there are no other mobs around there's a chance they will summon a Lv22 Deepmoss Matriarch.  It can be a mean surprise.

My advice to you is to leave the Ratchet and walk to the Crossroads. Once you get to Crossroads, take the west path out of Crossroads and just keep following that path. If you stick to that one road it will lead you straight upto the Stonetalon Mountains and into Windshear Crag where the eggs are.

It can be a little tricky, I actually managed to die on it once cause when I opened the eggs 2 little Deepmoss Hatchets popped out and the little suckers got me by surprise. Overall not too hard though, just be patient and it's no problem really. I was an 18 Warlock but the quest completion bumped me upto 19.
